clips.profile-name: Let's set up your child's profile. What's your child's name, or the nickname you use?
clips.profile-looks: What does your child look like? Things like hair, skin, and favorite clothes. This keeps them looking the same in every picture.
clips.profile-age: How old is your child? You can skip this one.
clips.profile-reading: How does your child do with reading? For example: not reading yet, short simple sentences, or reads well.
clips.profile-communication: How does your child usually communicate? For example: full sentences, short phrases, single words, or a device or app.
clips.profile-hard: What's hard for your child? Things like loud places, sudden noises, waiting, being touched, or meeting new people.
clips.profile-helps: What helps your child when things get hard?
clips.profile-comfort: Does your child have a comfort item, like a stuffed animal, a blanket, or headphones? If so, what does it look like?
clips.profile-loves: What does your child love? Favorite things, topics, or characters.
clips.profile-screen: On a phone or tablet, what can your child do comfortably? Tap things, drag things around, or type?
clips.profile-ways-in: Does your child take in stories best by reading, by listening, or by playing games?
clips.profile-anything-else: Is there anything else that would help us understand your child?
